latest.content:

Anemoi International Ltd (AMOI) AMOI announces pre-RTO Subscriptions
13-Aug-2026 / 07:30 GMT/BST
Anemoi International
Anemoi International Ltd
(Reuters: AMOI.L, Bloomberg: AMOI:LN)
(“Anemoi,” “AMOI”, or the “Company”)
AMOI announces pre-RTO Subscriptions
The Company is pleased to announce that it has entered into Advanced Subscription Agreements (‘ASA’) under which $2,200,000 of subscription funds have been provided by investors to the Company ahead of the previously announced Trasna reverse takeover transaction (‘RTO’). Under the terms of the ASA, funds are to be utilised as growth capital for Trasna and will convert into equity in the Company (to be renamed Trasna Ltd) at completion, at a 20% discount to the RTO pricing.
In the event, for whatever reason, the RTO does not complete, these advances will convert into shares in Trasna Solutions Technologies Limited.
Separately, the Company has entered into a further ASA for $1,000,000 which will be retained by Anemoi for growth capital, which will also convert into equity in the Company (to be renamed Trasna Ltd) at completion, at a 20% discount to the RTO pricing. In the event, for whatever reason, the RTO does not complete, these advances will convert into AMOI shares.
Duncan Soukup, Chairman of Anemoi
, commented: “I am pleased to report that the proposed Trasna RTO is progressing apace and, while there is always execution risk, I am confident that the prospects for completion by the end of Q3/2026 or early Q4/2026 remain realistic.”
END

latest.title: Appointment of CFO
latest.content:
Today 07:30
Anemoi International Ltd (AMOI) Appointment of CFO
06-Aug-2026 / 07:30 GMT/BST
Anemoi International
Anemoi International Ltd
(Reuters: AMOI.L, Bloomberg: AMOI:LN)
("Anemoi" or the "Company")
Appointment of Interim CFO
The Company is pleased to announce the appointment of David Blake as Interim Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, subject to final appointment procedures with the Company’s registered agent.
David joins the Board at an important stage in the Company's development and will lead the Group's finance function while supporting the Board in the execution of its strategic objectives and proposed reverse takeover with Trasna.
David is an experienced Board-level finance executive with more than 30 years' international commercial, financial and operational leadership experience across listed companies, privately owned businesses and complex transformation programmes.
Throughout his career he has led large-scale finance transformation, business restructuring, operational improvement, corporate governance, strategic planning, mergers and acquisitions, systems implementation and organisational change across a diverse range of sectors including technology, engineering, manufacturing, education, healthcare and business services.
The Board believes David's combination of strategic financial leadership, governance expertise, commercial judgement and transaction experience will provide valuable support as the Company progresses its strategic priorities.
Duncan Soukup, Chairman of Anemoi
, commented:
“We are delighted to welcome David to the Board as interim CFO to help progress the Trasna reverse takeover during this exciting time for Anemoi
.”
END

Final Results For Year Ended 31 December 2025
The information set out below is extracted from the Company's Report and Accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025, which will shortly be published on the Company's website. A copy will also be submitted to the National Storage Mechanism where it will be available for inspection.

2025 HIGHLIGHTS
Appointment of Canaccord Genuity as Sponsor and Lead Book Runner to the Trasna RTO announced 28 April 2026
2025 also marked a major shift in id4 strategy which is now focused on collaborative sales with a major consulting company with over 90,000 consultants and 50,000 clients Worldwide, and systems integrators such as Azilen and and Zigram and Pension Platform provider Opsio.
Id4 order inquiry, as at the time of writing, has now surpassed £750K which bodes well for the future.
CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT
2025 was clearly a year of multiple changes, which included the announcement of the RTO with Trasna, and the repositioning of id4.
The search for a suitable RTO candidate is never easy but when eventually one finds one, as I believe we have with Trasna, there is an enormous sense of satisfaction. Now the real work begins to successfully complete the transaction.
I would like to also emphasise the turnaround underway at id4. The Board and I have never doubted the merits of the software developed by the id4 Team, frustratingly, however, they were initially unsuccessful at converting that promise into meaningful sales but with order inquiries in excess of £750K through Q1 2026 the Company is experiencing its Phoenix rebirth…let’s hope that they can now turn the inquiries into sales!
Anemoi’s journey since going public has been nothing short of bumpy. The Anemoi, the Greek Gods of Wind, was originally formed with the idea of identifying a renewable power business, which it successfully did. Agreement was reached to acquire Europe’s largest onshore wind Farm project in Ukraine. Unfortunately, the 450 MW project happened to be in the Crimea and was subsequently (forcibly!) acquired by the invading Russian army. As a result of the Ukraine war and the loss of the target asset, the Board undertook the acquisition of id4, which is how we got to where we are today. Ss stated, a bumpy ride but one that now has a real chance of success thanks to the improving outlook at id4 and the proposed RTO transaction with Trasna.
The Board and I are grateful for the commitment of the Company’s Management and Staff and to shareholder’s who now have a real chance to benefit from the Board’s perseverance with id4 and the announced Trasna RTO.
Duncan Soukup
Chairman

company_30s.what_they_do: Anemoi International Ltd. builds and sells software that helps businesses manage and secure their digital identities. The core product is a cloud‑based platform that verifies user credentials, enforces multi‑factor authentication, and protects against fraud for online services.
company_30s.why_they_matter: Identity verification is a growing need for banks, e‑commerce sites and government portals. With cyber‑threats rising, organisations are spending more on secure login solutions. Anemoi’s platform is lightweight, easy to integrate, and targets mid‑market clients that can’t afford expensive enterprise suites.
company_30s.current_state: The company is in a transition phase: it has just completed a reverse takeover and is raising capital through pre‑RTO subscriptions. It is still operating at a loss and its cash burn is high, but the new capital injection and the acquisition of Trasna are expected to broaden its product range and improve revenue streams.

rns_narrative: The latest RNS releases show a company that is actively reshaping itself. First, Anemoi completed a reverse takeover to bring in new shareholders and a fresh board. Second, it announced a pre‑RTO subscription round that will raise fresh capital, signalling confidence from institutional investors. Third, the acquisition of Trasna is a strategic move to add complementary technology and expand the customer base.
These three events cluster around a theme of consolidation and capital raising – the company is pulling together resources to move from a survival mode into a growth trajectory.
The announcement of a CFO and a new partnership with ID4 and Azilen suggests the management is focused on stabilising operations and securing additional revenue streams.

crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bullish chatter is almost absent; the few bullish comments point to the pre‑RTO subscriptions and the Trasna deal as potential game‑changers.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears worry that the company is still far from profitability, that the reverse takeover may dilute existing shareholders, and that the cash burn could outpace the new funding.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The market has gone from silent to a handful of cautious optimism, but the overall mood remains indifferent. No sustained narrative is emerging.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat, meaning there is no public buzz. This lack of noise creates a perfect window for a surprise catalyst to generate a sharp rebound.

near_term_catalysts: Completion of the pre‑RTO subscription round – if the capital raise closes at the target level, the share price could receive a lift from the influx of funds.
First quarterly earnings report post‑reverse takeover – a positive surprise in revenue or margin could spark buying.
Announcement of a new partnership or product launch that leverages Trasna’s technology.
Any regulatory approval for the sale of Trasna or the integration of its platform.
expect_next.watch_for: Key signals to monitor over the next 2–3 months are: (1) the actual amount raised in the subscription round, (2) the first earnings release after the takeover, and (3) any press about the integration of Trasna’s product suite. A spike in trading volume or a sudden spike in social chatter would also confirm a catalyst.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early stages of a capitulation cycle – the price has fallen sharply and volume has thinned. If the new capital injection and the acquisition are successful, the next phase will be a gradual recovery. The APEX compression score suggests a tight range, so a breakout could be sharp but limited in scope.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: The company has just raised capital and added a new acquisition that expands its product line. If the market starts to price in the upside from the reverse takeover and the new funding, the share could rebound by 200–400% if it reaches the midpoint between its all‑time high and the current level. The signal hierarchy would place this as a purple (accumulation) setup once institutional interest shows up, which historically has a 44–50% win rate but can deliver outsized returns.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The biggest risk is that the company remains unprofitable and the cash burn continues. If the reverse takeover dilutes shareholders and the new capital is insufficient to cover operating costs, the share could stay flat or fall further. A realistic worst‑case scenario is a 10–20% decline from the current level if the market doubts the company’s turnaround plan.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential upside is 3–4 times the current price if the company hits the midpoint of its historic range. The downside is limited to the current price (the share could fall to zero but that is unlikely given the new capital). The asymmetry is roughly 1:3 to 1:4, favouring a contrarian long stance.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter on a dip after the first earnings release or after the subscription round closes. Allocate 20% of the discretionary portfolio, use a stop 30% below the entry to protect against a false breakout, and trail the stop as the price climbs.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for a clear volume spike (at least 50% above the 20‑day average) coupled with a news announcement (e.g., new partnership or earnings beat). That would signal that institutional buyers are stepping in.
playbook.if_passing: No immediate terminal risk is evident, so this section is left blank.

ai_insights.bottom_line: Anemoi is a deep‑crashed, cash‑burning tech company that just pulled in fresh capital and an acquisition; if the market prices in the upside from those moves, the share could rebound sharply, offering a highly asymmetric reward.
